textos.A maioria de quem recomenda destaca o po: Most of those who recommend it highlight the film's power to move and the existential questions it provokes. On the other hand, on a reduced base of accounts, most of those who do not recommend it concentrate their reservations on how the ending is handled and on the way the main message is conveyed.
textos.Execução da mensagem e resolução da tram: Execution of the message and resolution of the plot
textos.Várias reviews apontam que o filme abraç: Several reviews point out that the film embraces a message about the finitude of life but contradicts it by granting the protagonist a second chance, which feels cowardly and weakens the lesson it proposes.
textos.Este grupo descreve a obra como entedian: This group describes the work as boring and repetitive, with a first half that drags on and existential discussions that break the rhythm of the narrative.
textos.Estrutura e originalidade do roteiro: Structure and originality of the script
textos.As críticas negativas comparam a estrutu: The negative reviews compare the structure to a formula already seen in other films from the studio, saying the plot seems assembled from a list of predictable beats with no creative daring.
textos.Algumas reviews consideram a personagem: Some reviews consider the supporting character annoying and the jokes repetitive, and also criticize voice casting choices and the difficulty of getting attached to the protagonist.
textos.Tratamento do além e da espiritualidade: Treatment of the afterlife and spirituality
textos.Parte do grupo rejeita a forma como o al: A portion of the group rejects the way the afterlife is portrayed, finding the approach lukewarm, commercial or simplistic, and questions the role of religiosity and Black culture in this construction.
textos.Vários textos lamentam que ideias intere: Several texts lament that interesting ideas about art, purpose and identity were wasted on an execution that neither goes deep nor commits to its own premises.
textos.Mensagem central arrastada ou contraditó: Central message drawn out or contradictory
textos.Este grupo destaca que, embora a mensage: This group highlights that, although the message about enjoying life is beautiful, it is conveyed in a confusing or contradictory way, with ideas that do not hold up to the end.
textos.Animação visualmente bela, mas estilo ou: Visually beautiful animation, but questionable style or worldbuilding
textos.As reviews medianas elogiam a qualidade: Middling reviews praise the quality of the animation but criticize the design of the spiritual world as generic or uninspired, and the internal logic as at times incoherent.
textos.Várias reviews apontam que o filme não s: Several reviews point out that the film does not know whether it is for children or adults, mixing childish jokes with complex existential themes, resulting in an uneven experience.
textos.Protagonista egocêntrico e difícil de to: Self-centered protagonist who is hard to root for
textos.Algumas reviews medianas reclamam que o: Some middling reviews complain that the protagonist is excessively self-focused and not very likable, which makes it hard to connect with the story.
textos.Algumas pessoas do grupo medianas elogia: Some people in the middling group praise the music and the passages that manage to move, even when the rest of the film does not reach the same impact.
textos.Ritmo lento ou desenvolvimento insuficie: Slow pace or insufficient development of ideas
textos.Este grupo menciona que a narrativa demo: This group mentions that the narrative is slow to get going or leaves interesting concepts underexplored, such as the soul's journey and the development of the characters.
textos.Valorização do cotidiano e das pequenas: Appreciation of everyday life and small things
textos.As reviews destacam que a mensagem centr: The reviews highlight that the central message lies in appreciating small everyday moments, like a conversation, a song or watching the sky, instead of focusing only on great achievements.
textos.Crítica à obsessão por propósito e paixã: Critique of the obsession with purpose and passion
textos.Várias análises apontam que o filme ques: Several analyses point out that the film questions the need to find a grand purpose or a single passion, suggesting that life is not just that and that excessive pursuit can be harmful.
textos.Muitos espectadores relatam que o longa: Many viewers report that the film provoked existential crises, deep reflections on their own lives and even crying, working as a reminder to live in the present.
textos.Qualidade da animação e da trilha sonora: Quality of the animation and the soundtrack
textos.As reviews elogiam a animação visualment: The reviews praise the visually stunning animation and the engaging soundtrack, with emphasis on the mix of jazz and ethereal music that contributes to the film's atmosphere.
textos.Jazz como elemento temático e inspirador: Jazz as a thematic and inspiring element
textos.O jazz é mencionado não apenas como part: Jazz is mentioned not just as part of the plot but as a force that inspires and gives meaning to life, encouraging some to rediscover the pleasure of music.
textos.Algumas reviews destacam a atuação do el: Some reviews highlight the cast's performances, especially Jamie Foxx's, and the construction of characters like Joe and 22, who generate identification and empathy.

textos.Lançado em 2020 e dirigido por Pete Doct: Released in 2020 and directed by Pete Docter, Soul is an animation that blends drama, fantasy and music in a family-oriented production. The plot follows a music teacher who aspires to play at a traditional New York jazz club but, after an accident that carries his soul out of his body, finds himself having to traverse another reality alongside a young soul in an attempt to take back his life.
textos.A narrativa alterna entre a ambientação: The narrative alternates between an urban setting with a strong musical presence and an abstract conceptual realm, structured around a meditative pace and themes of an existential nature.
textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~80%), dest: In the vast majority of ratings (~80%), appreciation of everyday life and of life's small moments stands out, an aspect emphasized by many. A good portion also highlight the critique of the obsessive pursuit of a great passion or a definitive purpose. In addition, a significant share point to the strong emotional impact provoked by the work and its existential reflections.
textos.Para quem se situa numa parcela das nota: For those who sit at a share of the ratings (~16%), the perception comes with reservations: several judge that the central message becomes contradictory or loses force over the course of the development. In this same group, some raise questions about the logic and style of the spiritual universe, although they note its visual beauty, while a smaller slice identifies uncertainties of tone regarding the target audience.
textos.Já numa fração mínima das notas (~4%), a: In a minimal fraction of ratings (~4%), the reading focuses on weaknesses in how the story is handled. Some of them consider the resolution of the plot incoherent with the initial proposal, while others report a drawn-out pace that causes weariness. Finally, some point to a lack of originality in the script's structure, considering it predictable.
